findings.description: The new logarithm can raise ValueError when max / multiplier underflows to zero, instead of returning the capped wait.
findings.rationale: With multiplier=1e200, max=1e-200, exp_base=2 and attempt_number=1, all preceding guards pass, but max / multiplier becomes 0.0. math.log(0.0, 2) raises ValueError outside the try block, aborting retry processing; the original calculation returns 1e-200.
